name: MOG Antibody-Associated Disease
definition: Inflammatory demyelinating disorder associated with antibodies against myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein, presenting with optic neuritis, myelitis, ADEM or other CNS syndromes.

typical: Brainstem or cortical syndromes may occur

investigations.principle: Serum MOG-IgG testing with an appropriate cell-based assay plus MRI brain/spine is central to diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Relapse-prevention strategy is individualized; diagnosis should not be inferred from MRI alone.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neurological phenotype may be documented only in parallel with modern neuroimmunologic diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammatory demyelinating disorder associated with antibodies against myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein, presenting with optic neuritis, myelitis, ADEM or other CNS syndromes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
